name: stellate
description: A generative music instrument you play by moving through a map of 250 genres — every song rendered live in the browser and fully deterministic from a seed.

scripts.test:pure: node test/theory.test.js && node test/pipes.test.js && node test/boot-smoke.js
scripts.test:browser: for t in test/*-run.js; do echo "== $t =="; node "$t" || exit 1; done

//: The MATRIX/VALIDATE/ENGINE gates (verify.sh) and the pure-node tests need NO deps beyond Node. The BROWSER gates (test/*-run.js — real WebGL/WebAudio via Playwright) need this one devDependency: run `npm install` then `npm run setup:browser`, after which `node test/<name>-run.js` works with no NODE_PATH. Faust's own build dep installs separately under engine/faust (see CONTRIBUTING).
